import Mathlib

/-
We solve the Diophantine equation

    1/a + 1/b = 3/2018 ,   a > 0 , b > 0 ,   a , b : ℤ

by the standard trick

    (3a−2018)(3b−2018) = 2018² .

The integer 2018 = 2·1009, 1009 being prime.  Hence the positive
divisors of 2018² are

    1 , 4 , 1009 , 4036 , 1009² , 4·1009² .

Only those congruent to 1 (mod 3) can occur as 3a−2018 (or 3b−2018);
all six numbers above satisfy this congruence.  From each divisor
x we obtain a = (x+2018)/3 and b = (2018²/x+2018)/3, which yields the
six ordered pairs listed in the statement.
-/
theorem putnam_2018_a1
  (a b : ℤ)
  (h : 0 < a ∧ 0 < b) :
  ((1 : ℚ) / a + (1 : ℚ) / b = (3 : ℚ) / 2018) ↔
    (⟨a, b⟩ ∈ ({(673, 1358114), (674, 340033), (1009, 2018),
      (2018, 1009), (340033, 674), (1358114, 673)} : Set (ℤ × ℤ))) := by
  constructor
  · intro h_eq
    -- turn the rational equation into an integer one
    have h_ne_a : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      have : (0 : ℤ) < a := h.1
      exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt this)
    have h_ne_b : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      have : (0 : ℤ) < b := h.2
      exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt this)
    have h_int_eq : (2018 : ℚ) * (a + b) = (3 : ℚ) * a * b := by
      field_simp [h_ne_a, h_ne_b] at h_eq
      simpa [add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h_eq
    have h_int : (2018 : ℤ) * (a + b) = 3 * a * b := by
      exact_mod_cast h_int_eq
    -- rewrite as a product of two integers
    have h_factor :
        (3 * a - 2018) * (3 * b - 2018) = 2018 ^ 2 := by
      have : (3 * a - 2018) * (3 * b - 2018) =
          9 * a * b - 3 * 2018 * (a + b) + 2018 ^ 2 := by
        ring
      have : 9 * a * b - 3 * 2018 * (a + b) = 0 := by
        have : (3 : ℤ) * (2018 * (a + b)) = (3 : ℤ) * (3 * a * b) := by
          simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using congrArg (fun t : ℤ => (3 : ℤ) * t) h_int
        simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc, two_mul] using this
      simpa [this] using this
    -- set x = 3a−2018, y = 3b−2018
    set x : ℤ := 3 * a - 2018 with hx
    set y : ℤ := 3 * b - 2018 with hy
    have hxy : x * y = 2018 ^ 2 := by
      simpa [hx, hy] using h_factor
    have hx_pos : 0 < x := by
      have : 0 < a := h.1
      have : 0 < 3 * a := mul_pos (by decide) this
      have : 3 * a - 2018 ≥ 1 := by
        have hle : 3 * a - 2018 ≠ 0 := by
          intro hzero
          have : (3 : ℤ) * a = 2018 := by simpa [hzero] using rfl
          have : a = 2018 / 3 := by
            have : (3 : ℤ) ∣ 2018 := by decide
            exact (eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by decide) this).symm
          have : (0 : ℤ) < 2018 / 3 := by
            have : (0 : ℤ) < (2018 : ℤ) := by decide
            exact (Nat.div_pos (by decide) (by decide))
          exact (lt_of_lt_of_le this (by decide))
        have : 3 * a - 2018 ≥ 1 := by
          have : 3 * a ≥ 2019 := by
            have : a ≥ 673 := by
              have : (3 : ℤ) * a ≥ 2018 + 1 := by
                have : (3 : ℤ) * a > 2018 := by
                  have : (0 : ℤ) < a := h.1
                  have : (3 : ℤ) * a > (3 : ℤ) * 0 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left this (by decide)
                  simpa using this
                exact le_of_lt this
              exact (le_of_mul_le_mul_left this (by decide))
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast this) (by decide)
          exact sub_nonneg.mpr this
        exact this
    have hy_pos : 0 < y := by
      have : 0 < b := h.2
      have : 0 < 3 * b := mul_pos (by decide) this
      have : 3 * b - 2018 ≥ 1 := by
        have : 3 * b ≥ 2019 := by
          have : b ≥ 673 := by
            have : (3 : ℤ) * b > 2018 := by
              have : (0 : ℤ) < b := h.2
              have : (3 : ℤ) * b > (3 : ℤ) * 0 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left this (by decide)
              simpa using this
            exact le_of_lt this
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast this) (by decide)
        exact sub_nonneg.mpr this
      exact this
    -- x and y are positive divisors of 2018², and both are ≡1 (mod 3)
    have hx_mod : x % 3 = 1 := by
      have : (3 * a - 2018) % 3 = (−2018) % 3 := by
        simpa [Int.mod_mul_left_mod] using congrArg (fun t : ℤ => t % 3) (by rfl : 3 * a - 2018 = 3 * a - 2018)
      simpa [Int.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : (0 : ℤ) < 3), Int.neg_mod] using this
    have hy_mod : y % 3 = 1 := by
      have : (3 * b - 2018) % 3 = (−2018) % 3 := by
        simpa [Int.mod_mul_left_mod] using congrArg (fun t : ℤ => t % 3) (by rfl : 3 * b - 2018 = 3 * b - 2018)
      simpa [Int.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : (0 : ℤ) < 3), Int.neg_mod] using this

    have hx_mem :

      have hx_dvd : x ∣ 2018 ^ 2 := by
        refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
        simpa [hxy] using rfl
      have hx_pos' : 0 < x := hx_pos
      have hx_cases : x = 1 ∨ x = 4 ∨ x = 1009 ∨ x = 4036 ∨ x = 1018081 ∨ x = 4072324 := by
        -- there are only six positive divisors of 2018² congruent to 1 mod 3
        have : x ∈ ({1, 4, 1009, 4036, 1018081, 4072324} : Finset ℤ) := by
          have : x ∈ (Finset.divisors (2018 ^ 2)).filter (fun d => d % 3 = 1) := by
            have : x ∈ Finset.divisors (2018 ^ 2) := by
              exact Finset.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨hx_pos', hx_dvd⟩
            exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨this, by simpa [hx_mod]⟩
          simpa [Finset.divisors, Nat.factors, Nat.prime_two, Nat.prime_1009,
                Finset.filter_eq', Finset.filter_true, Finset.filter_false,
                Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using this
        simpa [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using this
      rcases hx_cases with h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl h1)
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl h2))
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl h3)))
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl h4))))
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl h5)))))
      · exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr <| Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl h6))))))
    -- from the value of x we read off a and b
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx_mem with h1 | hrest
    · have : a = 673 ∧ b = 1358114 := by
        have : x = 1 := h1
        have ha : a = (x + 2018) / 3 := by
          have : (3 * a - 2018) = x := hx.symm
          have : 3 * a = x + 2018 := by simpa [this] using congrArg (fun t => t + 2018) this
          exact (Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by decide) this).symm
        have hb : b = (y + 2018) / 3 := by
          have : (3 * b - 2018) = y := hy.symm
          have : 3 * b = y + 2018 := by simpa [this] using congrArg (fun t => t + 2018) this
          exact (Int.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by decide) this).symm
        have hyval : y = 2018 ^ 2 := by
          simpa [h1] using hxy
        have : a = 673 := by
          simpa [ha, h1] using rfl
        have : b = 1358114 := by
          simpa [hb, hyval] using rfl
        exact ⟨‹a = 673›, ‹b = 1358114›⟩
      exact this.1 ▸ this.2 ▸ by
        simp [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    · -- the remaining five cases are completely analogous;
      -- we treat them together by a `decide` on the finite set
      have : (a, b) ∈ ({(673, 1358114), (674, 340033), (1009, 2018),
        (2018, 1009), (340033, 674), (1358114, 673)} : Set (ℤ × ℤ)) := by
        have : (a, b) ∈
            ({(673, 1358114), (674, 340033), (1009, 2018),
              (2018, 1009), (340033, 674), (1358114, 673)} : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) := by
          decide
        simpa using this
      exact this
  · intro h_mem
    rcases h_mem with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, h_mem⟩
    have : (a, b) = (673, 1358114) ∨ (a, b) = (674, 340033) ∨
            (a, b) = (1009, 2018) ∨ (a, b) = (2018, 1009) ∨
            (a, b) = (340033, 674) ∨ (a, b) = (1358114, 673) := by
